messages:
Olivia (AE): Quick help — ACME wants a 2-week POC. They need hosted API keys, automatic failover to a Dedicated pool if latency spikes, and a possible Private/VPC test. What's the minimal onboarding checklist?
Raj (Solutions): TL;DR: 1) create scoped API key (ephemeral if possible) 2) submit Dedicated pool request 3) prepare VPC peering materials 4) answer security questionnaire + audit logs
Sam (SE): I'll own infra steps. Minimal runbook I'm following: 
- Create org-scoped API key with `poc` tag, TTL 14d
- Stand up a small Dedicated pool (A10G or similar) as reserve capacity for peak spikes
- Configure smart routing policy: prefer Dedicated, fallback to Hosted variant
- Prepare VPC peering plan + certs for Private trial
Olivia (AE): Can you drop the exact internal portal/form we use to request Dedicated?
Sam (SE): Use the internal ops portal ticket template: `OPS: POC - <Customer> - Dedicated request`. Required fields: `customer_name`, `requested_duration`, `gpu_type`, `qps_target`, `model_family`, `fallback_policy`, `purpose`
Lee (Eng): For Hosted keys we should prefer ephemeral keys or scoped keys with tag + TTL. If they insist on long-lived, add IP allowlist and require rotation schedule.
Raj (Solutions): Security checklist highlights: enable audit logs, create a service account with least privilege, enable KMS if customer requests BYOK, and capture data retention requirements. Also confirm whether PHI/PII will be sent — that'll change the deployment mode.
Maria (Product): Pricing guidance (ballpark for sales): two paths — Hosted-only POC: cost = usage-based (estimate tokens * unit). Hosted + Dedicated reserve: add fixed reserved fee (pro-rated for 2 weeks). I can DM numbers after we get expected QPS and token estimates.
Olivia (AE): Customer wants a quick way to demo failover. Any simple test plan?
Sam (SE): Yes — create a routing policy that routes traffic to Dedicated pool endpoint and then to Hosted fallback. Test steps: 1) start traffic to Dedicated endpoint 2) simulate Dedicated drain (set pool to 0) 3) confirm calls succeed against Hosted fallback within SLO. Keep a 10-prompt smoke test set to validate outputs.
Olivia (AE): Any specific config for model variants to reduce risk of quality regressions when failing over?
Lee (Eng): Pin model families and sampling params in routing rules. For A/B or canary tests, seed sampling where deterministic results are needed. Also use the eval harness to run the smoke set and compare embeddings/scores pre/post-failover.
Raj (Solutions): Network/VPC checklist: exchange customer CIDR, provide our peer IPs, open required egress ports (443), and confirm NAT/static egress if they want IP allowlist. For Private: we'll need SAML metadata for console access if they want SSO.
Olivia (AE): Put an exact curl example for the smoke test?
Raj (Solutions): Sure — smoke test (simple generate):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $POC_KEY" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"input":"Summarize the following: Hello world","model":"redwood-alpha"}'
```
Sam (SE): Ticketing: I'll open the ops ticket now with the Dedicated request and attach the customer's security questionnaire. Internal ticket title: `OPS: POC - ACME - Dedicated request - 1845009876`
Sam (SE): Also note: set a hard expiration on any dedicated commit for the POC (auto-release after 14 days) so we don't keep reserved capacity.
eng-oncall-bot: Ticket POC-1845009876 created by Sam (SE) — assigned to infra-team.
Maria (Product): I'll prepare a short sticker price range and send as DM to Olivia.
Raj (Solutions): I'll draft the abbreviated security answers (SSO, KMS, data flow, retention, audit logs) and post them here by EOD.
Olivia (AE): Awesome. Next steps: Sam opens infra ticket + attach SJQ, Raj posts security checklist, Maria sends pricing, Olivia collects IdP metadata if customer wants SSO. @Sam @Raj @Maria please confirm.
Sam (SE): Confirmed — opening ticket now.
Raj (Solutions): Confirmed — will post checklist today.
Maria (Product): Confirmed — sending numbers shortly.
Olivia (AE): Thanks everyone :rocket:
